implemented_route: apps/cli -> Engine::execute/execute_inner -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::CalculateSequence -> Core scheduler observed upstream computation artifact -> language::calculate_sequence_expression accepts canonical exact rationals or canonical rational+unit values -> existing bounded calculate_unit_addition consumes compatible unit addition/subtraction -> step artifact retains consumed source SHA-256
supported_behavior: Sequence references can consume canonical exact rationals and exact rational quantity strings produced by the existing calculation engine.
A quantity reference is substituted as a bare number+unit token so the existing exact unit addition/subtraction parser can consume it without inventing a new dimensional operator.

The existing unit calculator admits identical declared units and exact mixed mm/cm/m/km conversions to metres; rational numeric lexemes such as 3/4 are retained and accepted for subsequent unit addition/subtraction.
Core still stores the source span, evaluated expression, exact calculation and actual upstream artifact digest for each step; Scheduler.observe enforces the exact prerequisite hash set.
known_limits: Unit-bearing references are limited to expressions accepted by the existing binary unit addition/subtraction implementation; dimensional multiplication and division remain unsupported.
The existing same-unit contract is string-based and does not provide general physical dimension validation.
No runtime, CLI, test or independent task-quality observation accompanies this source/build slice.
